free_visa_notes: Oman grants visa-free entry (up to 14 days) to nationals of over 100 countries per the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (fm.gov.om); this record covers the fees for nationalities that DO require a visa. No reciprocity-based fee schedule by specific nationality was found on official sources; the eVisa fee appears to be a flat structure by visa duration/type rather than by nationality. Oman's inbound eVisa process is handled directly via the Royal Oman Police portal (evisa.rop.gov.om), not through an outsourced VFS/TLS/BLS centre.
